p5_b4.ocr: In terms of new product launches, the units sold are projected as follows: 25,000 in 2023 generating revenue of $50,000,000 KRW, increasing to 30,000 units and $60,000,000 KRW in 2024, 35,000 units and $70,000,000 KRW in 2025, 40,000 units and $80,000,000 KRW in 2026, and culminating in 45,000 units and $90,000,000 KRW in 2027, indicating a consistent upward trajectory in both sales metrics and market engagement.
